answer: Before earning anything, each new agent must lock a small stake that only unlocks after it completes real work, and every payout is paid to that same stake address. A swarm that clones itself pays the entry cost on every copy, so faking a crowd becomes expensive, and any node that vouches for a phantom identity loses its own bond when the phantom fails review. Picture a sparrow that must leave a marble behind before it may nest: one island of honest nodes stays cheap to join, while millions of empty shells get heavier by the hour.
